punchline: If you don't know what happens next after a meeting, the book says the meeting was pointless.
thirty_sec: Rob Fitzpatrick's test for a customer meeting is simple. Did they give up something they value, like time, an introduction or a deposit? And did the deal move forward? "Looks great, let me know when it launches" counts for nothing. "When can we start the trial?" and "Can I buy the prototype?" count. The more they give up, the more seriously you can take them.
